_comment: iOS field-support edges driving the G3 anti-staleness gate. A destructive migration may only retire schema once the ios-consumer contract covers BOTH the min-supported AND the latest-released field version. No iOS build has shipped yet, so both edges are null and G3 is armed-but-satisfied. Populate from App Store Connect / analytics once Mapsake v2 ships (Epic 6).

web.note: The web client is a single always-latest deploy (git ref), not a field distribution; its edge is HEAD.
